outputs.speech_rate: Syllables per second from the first to the last word (syll/s)
outputs.articulation_rate: Syllables per second relative to speech time (syll/s)
outputs.speech_rate_variability: Standard deviation of the rate across windows (syll/s)

syllable_method.description: Syllable counting: nuclei (vowel nuclei by language rules: cs, de, it, es, fr; other languages fall back to pyphen) or pyphen (hyphenation dictionary as in the legacy script, any language with a Pyphen dictionary)

speech_time.description: Speech time for the articulation rate: words (sum of word durations from Whisper as in the legacy script), segments_in_words (segmentation speech only inside word intervals, i.e. the segmentation cuts out pauses that Whisper absorbed into a word) or segments (all speech from the segmentation)

language.description: Language for syllable counting; empty = take it from the transcript
